questions.q: Why does this capstone use Redshift Serverless instead of a provisioned Redshift cluster?
options: Northfield's query pattern is bursty (heavy at month-end, quiet otherwise), and Serverless bills per RPU-second with auto-pause instead of billing hourly regardless of use
Provisioned clusters cannot run SQL COPY commands
Redshift Serverless is required for any table using a DISTKEY
Serverless is simply newer, with no cost-related reason
questions.explain: Lesson 1 established Northfield's bursty query pattern; Serverless's per-RPU-second billing and auto-pause map directly onto that usage shape.

questions.q: What is the fastest way to bulk-load curated S3 data into analytics.fact_orders, per this lesson?
options: The COPY command, which loads in parallel across Redshift's compute nodes
Individual INSERT statements for each row
Manually uploading a CSV through the Redshift console
A Lambda function that writes one row at a time
questions.explain: COPY loads directly from S3 in parallel across compute nodes, far faster than row-by-row INSERTs.

questions.q: What DISTKEY and SORTKEY does analytics.fact_orders use, and why?
options: DISTKEY customer_id (colocates rows for customer joins) and SORTKEY dt (matches date-range query patterns)
DISTKEY order_id and SORTKEY product_sku, chosen at random
No DISTKEY or SORTKEY are used on this table
DISTKEY region and SORTKEY customer_id
questions.explain: DISTKEY(customer_id) colocates a customer's rows for fast dim_customer joins; SORTKEY(dt) lets Redshift skip blocks of unrelated dates for 'last month' style queries.

questions.q: What IAM role authorizes the COPY command to read from northfield-curated-zone?
options: northfield-redshift-copy-role
northfield-glue-role
northfield-stepfunctions-role
No IAM role is needed for COPY
questions.explain: The COPY command's IAM_ROLE parameter references northfield-redshift-copy-role, scoped in Lesson 10 to only the curated zone bucket.

questions.q: What tables make up northfielddw's star schema in the analytics schema?
options: analytics.fact_orders plus dim_product, dim_customer, and dim_date
A single denormalized orders table with no dimensions
analytics.northfield_orders_raw and northfield_inventory_raw
fact_orders only, with dimensions stored in DynamoDB
questions.explain: The schema is a small star: fact_orders joined against dim_product, dim_customer, and dim_date.
